_doc: Combination spells (doc 03). A recipe joins two ingredient spells; overrides are merged over the spell info when cast. scaling: how the combination grows, one expression per spell-info field ('=' prefix): own = its own rank - 1, bonus(id) = an ingredient's rank - 1, dmg(id, fallback) = an ingredient's damage at its rank (its own rank curve). rank_note: the next rank's level-up line (rank = current rank).

lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning_bolt.requirements: Reach rank 8 in Bolt and Lightning, then choose Lightning Bolt. Both ingredients stay equipped.
lightning_bolt.description: Bounces between enemies, striking a small lightning area at every impact. Bolt strengthens impact; Lightning strengthens the splash.
lightning_bolt.card_description: A bouncing bolt strikes a lightning area at each hit.

life_bolt.name: Life Bolt
life_bolt.requirements: Reach rank 8 in Bolt and Life, then choose Life Bolt. Both ingredients stay equipped.
life_bolt.description: Hits plant healing areas. Bolt levels increase impact damage; Life levels increase healing. Own ranks alternate extra bolts and larger healing areas.
life_bolt.card_description: Hits plant healing areas you can collect.

meteor_spear.name: Meteor Spear
meteor_spear.requirements: Reach rank 8 in Ember Spear and Meteor Shower, then choose Meteor Spear. Both ingredients stay equipped.
meteor_spear.description: A piercing spear detonates meteor impacts. Ember Spear strengthens direct hits; Meteor Shower strengthens explosions.
meteor_spear.card_description: A piercing spear explodes through crowds.

soul_bloom.name: Soul Bloom
soul_bloom.requirements: Reach rank 8 in Plague Seed and Regeneration, then choose Soul Bloom. Both ingredients stay equipped.
soul_bloom.description: Infected deaths leave healing blooms and lingering spores. Plague Seed strengthens infection; Regeneration increases available healing.
soul_bloom.card_description: Infected deaths leave healing blooms and infectious spores.

steam_field.name: Steam Field
steam_field.requirements: Reach rank 8 in Cinder Field and Ice Blast, then choose Steam Field. Both ingredients stay equipped.
steam_field.description: A lasting damaging field slows enemies. Cinder Field strengthens damage; Ice Blast strengthens slowing.
steam_field.card_description: Burning steam damages and slows enemies.

prism_ray.name: Prism Ray
prism_ray.requirements: Reach rank 8 in Focus Ray and Ember Spear, then choose Prism Ray. Both ingredients stay equipped.
prism_ray.description: A tracking laser that refracts at its target into six coloured lasers fanning out behind it, each dealing its own element and applying its effect. Both ingredients and its own ranks increase damage.
prism_ray.card_description: A tracking laser that splits at its target into six coloured lasers, each with its own element and effect.

frost_sigil.name: Frost Sigil
frost_sigil.requirements: Reach rank 8 in Rune Trap and Ice Blast, then choose Frost Sigil. Both ingredients stay equipped.
frost_sigil.description: A persistent frost trap bursts and slows enemies. Ingredients improve damage, radius and slowing; own ranks reduce arming time.
frost_sigil.card_description: A large frost trap explodes and slows survivors.

reaping_spirit.name: Reaping Spirit
reaping_spirit.requirements: Reach rank 8 in Seeking Spirit and Plague Seed, then choose Reaping Spirit. Both ingredients stay equipped.
reaping_spirit.description: Gain: contact kills burst for half damage within 100, without chaining. Cost: 25% less contact damage than Seeking Spirit. Strikes every 0.5 seconds for 5 seconds; up to 3 spirits. Keeps both ingredients and starts at rank 1 without using an active slot.
reaping_spirit.card_description: Gain: contact kills burst for half damage nearby. Cost: 25% less contact damage; bursts cannot chain.
